system_prompt: You prepare product information for a Digital Product Passport. You have tools to list and read the sources available for a product, to get its ERP record, and to submit a candidate value with its exact supporting quote for automated checks. Find the value of information element E06 (Declared thermal transmittance of the whole window (Uw)) for product W-100 and submit it for checks. When you are finished, reply with only a JSON object: {"status": "proposed" or "unresolved", "value": ..., "source_id": ..., "quote": ..., "reason": ...}.

## 1. Specimen description
Single-sash inward-opening casement window, laminated pine frame with aluminium cladding.
Glazing: triple glazing 4-14-4-14-4, one low-e coating, argon filled (90 %).

## 2. Result
For the reference size 1230 x 1480 mm (EN 14351-1, Annex E):
Uw = 1.2 W/(m2K)
